guide.intake: Choose one of eight input types, add your target, and select Start design. The demo moves through Target, Site, Design, Pilot, Scale and Candidates automatically.
guide.demo: All outputs use a fixed lysozyme/VHH example: 8 pilot candidates → 24 scale candidates → 6 finalists. The design demo does not call a model or submit GPU jobs. Doudou chat separately uses the DeepSeek API.
guide.files: Files stay in your browser. Structure files receive a lightweight coordinate check; PSE and Target Bundle dependencies still need backend validation. File bytes are not stored. Downloaded scores are illustrative, without synthesis-ready sequences.
guide.pro: Your Pro workspace stays separate. Real backend integration will preserve scientific approvals and ask for your input when needed.
